Carmen: Partner asked for a concise HW gating checklist covering H100/H200, MI300, B200 and a single-line Gaudi roadmap note. Need matrix + embargo handshake by Thu EOD.
Ethan: Ill draft the matrix. Need perf + SI windows. @Vik can you confirm staging ETA?
Vik: MI300 tomorrow 08:00 PST, H200 12:00, H100 18:00. B200 thermal pass at 20:00 (expect lower perf if capped). Logs to gs://redwood-staging/gpu-compat/3921000000/.
Pri: SI can run dry-run Fri AM. Post exact runtime tags and kernel. One-liner runbook please.
Lina: Tags (WIP): `redwood/runtime:1.3.0-mi300-rc`, `...-h200-rc`, `...-h100-rc`, `...-b200-rc`, kernel 5.15.140 + nvidia-548-rc`.
Ethan: Embargo handshake (short): share matrix -> 72h partner review -> 48h final signoff (email/Jira ack required) -> 24-48h canary (dedicated first). Fallback: delay public list + publish hotfix plan.
Pri: Canary routing: dedicated/us-west-2 (3%) -> broad canary (20%) -> GA. Exclude Hosted first 48h.
Carmen: Action owners: Ethan matrix + embargo (Thu EOD), Vik perf logs (Thu night), Pri SI dry-run (Fri AM), Lina driver hashes (Thu AM).
ops-bot: Created event "HW Gating Review: H100/H200/MI300/B200" Thu 09:00 PST.
Ethan: Will post matrix link here when ready.
Vik: Uploading logs now.
Pri: SI invites sent once matrix posted.
Carmen: Keep partner text tight and non-committal for Gaudi (roadmap note only).
